Fake ads

For a year, KIOSK gave us the advertising space in Metropolis M. We filled it with fake ads: the language of marketing turned on censorship, political manipulation, environmental crisis and technology that goes too far. Each page asks readers to look again at the stories they are sold.

With Maria Ghetti. See it on KIOSK.
